Build an animated capybara riding a hoverboard using only HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

Deliver a single self-contained HTML file with all CSS and JavaScript inline. Do not use external libraries, external image assets, external fonts, or network requests. Inline SVG, CSS drawing, and canvas are allowed.

The result should visibly show a capybara riding a hoverboard, with animation that makes the scene feel alive. Do not include audio.

Return only the HTML source, without explanations or Markdown code fences.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Capybara Hoverboard Cruise</title>
<style>
  :root {
    --ui-bg: rgba(18, 14, 36, 0.72);
    --ui-border: rgba(255, 214, 138, 0.35);
    --ui-accent: #ff9e44;
    --ui-cyan: #2bf0ff;
    --ui-pink: #ff3e9d;
    --ui-text: #fff7eb;
  }

  * {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
  }

  html, body {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #120924;
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    color: var(--ui-text);
  }

  #scene-container {
    position: relative;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    cursor: crosshair;
  }

  #world-canvas {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: block;
    z-index: 1;
  }

  #stage-overlay {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 2;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  #capy-rig-wrapper {
    position: relative;
    width: min(640px, 88vw);
    height: min(480px, 68vh);
    transform-origin: 50% 65%;
    will-change: transform;
  }

  #capy-svg {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: visible;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 12px 24px rgba(10, 4, 26, 0.45));
  }

  #fx-canvas {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 3;
  }

  /* HUD Controls */
  .hud-top {
    position: absolute;
    top: 20px;
    left: 24px;
    right: 24px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: flex-start;
    z-index: 10;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .brand-card {
    background: var(--ui-bg);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 12px 18px;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    pointer-events: auto;
  }

  .brand-title {
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ffe28a, #ff8f52, #ff4da6, #2bf0ff);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    background-clip: text;
    color: transparent;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .brand-sub {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255, 247, 235, 0.78);
    margin-top: 3px;
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  }

  .telemetry {
    display: flex;
    gap: 12px;
    pointer-events: auto;
  }

  .stat-pill {
    background: var(--ui-bg);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 10px 15px;
    min-width: 105px;
    text-align: center;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
  }

  .stat-label {
    font-size: 10px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    color: rgba(255, 247, 235, 0.65);
    margin-bottom: 2px;
  }

  .stat-value {
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 800;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    color: #ffe396;
    text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255, 174, 52, 0.45);
  }

  .stat-value.cyan {
    color: #6df6ff;
    text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(43, 240, 255, 0.5);
  }

  .hud-bottom {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 22px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    z-index: 10;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 10px;
    background: var(--ui-bg);
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 8px 14px;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
    max-width: 94vw;
  }

  .ctrl-btn {
    appearance: none;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    color: var(--ui-text);
    padding: 8px 15px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .ctrl-btn:hover {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
    border-color: rgba(255, 224, 150, 0.65);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(255, 158, 68, 0.3);
  }

  .ctrl-btn:active {
    transform: translateY(0) scale(0.96);
  }

  .ctrl-btn.active {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff8533, #ff3385);
    border-color: #ffe299;
    box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(255, 77, 150, 0.6);
  }

  .kbd-hint {
    font-size: 10px;
    padding: 2px 6px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  @media (max-width: 680px) {
    .hud-top {
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: stretch;
    }
    .telemetry {
      justify-content: space-between;
    }
    .stat-pill {
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 0;
      padding: 8px 10px;
    }
    .kbd-hint {
      display: none;
    }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div id="scene-container">
  <canvas id="world-canvas"></canvas>

  <div id="stage-overlay">
    <div id="capy-rig-wrapper">
      <svg id="capy-svg" viewBox="0 0 700 540" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <defs>
          <!-- Capybara Fur Gradients -->
          <linearGradient id="capyBodyGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="85%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#c6864e"/>
            <stop offset="48%" stop-color="#a86834"/>
            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#76421b"/>
          </linearGradient>

          <linearGradient id="capyHeadGrad" x1="15%" y1="0%" x2="90%" y2="95%">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#cf8f56"/>
            <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#ad6d39"/>
            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#814b21"/>
          </linearGradient>

          <linearGradient id="capySnoutGrad" x1="0%" y1="10%" x2="100%" y2="90%">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#85502a"/>
            <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#62381a"/>
            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#482710"/>
          </linearGradient>

          <linearGradient id="capyLegGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#8f5529"/>
            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#4d2911"/>
          </linearGradient>

          <linearGradient id="capyBellyGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#b87842" stop-opacity="0"/>
            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#613314" stop-opacity="0.75"/>
          </linearGradient>

          <!-- Yuzu Fruit Gradient -->
          <radialGradient id="yuzuGrad" cx="35%" cy="30%" r="70%">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fff380"/>
            <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#ffc425"/>
            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e07b00"/>
          </radialGradient>

          <!-- Scarf Gradient -->
          <linearGradient id="scarfGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="20%">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff2a6d"/>
            <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#ff5e3a"/>
            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffaa2b"/>
          </linearGradient>

          <!-- Hoverboard Gradients -->
          <linearGradient id="deckTopGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="30%">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#2b3054"/>
            <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#424a78"/>
            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1d213b"/>
          </linearGradient>

          <linearGradient id="deckRimGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff2e93"/>
            <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#ff9a3c"/>
            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#00f6ff"/>
          </linearGradient>

          <linearGradient id="deckBaseGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#16182e"/>
            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#090a14"/>
          </linearGradient>

          <radialGradient id="thrusterGlowGrad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
            <stop offset="35%" stop-color="#5cfaff"/>
            <stop offset="72%" stop-color="#00a2ff" stop-opacity="0.65"/>
            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0066ff" stop-opacity="0"/>
          </radialGradient>

          <radialGradient id="pinkGlowGrad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fff0f8"/>
            <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#ff3ea5"/>
            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ff0077" stop-opacity="0"/>
          </radialGradient>

          <!-- Cyber Visor Gradient -->
          <linearGradient id="visorGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="20%">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#00f6ff"/>
            <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#7b2cbf"/>
            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ff2a85"/>
          </linearGradient>

          <filter id="neonGlow" x="-40%" y="-40%" width="180%" height="180%">
            <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="6" result="blur"/>
            <feMerge>
              <feMergeNode in="blur"/>
              <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
            </feMerge>
          </filter>
        </defs>

        <!-- MASTER RIG GROUP -->
        <g id="rig-root" transform="translate(350, 310)">

          <!-- HOVERBOARD GROUP -->
          <g id="hoverboard-group" transform="translate(0, 72)">
            <!-- Anti-gravity Ground Pulse Rings (SVG layer synced with board) -->
            <g id="repulsor-waves">
              <ellipse id="wave-rear" cx="-135" cy="52" rx="58" ry="15" fill="none" stroke="#2bf0ff" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.6"/>
              <ellipse id="wave-front" cx="135" cy="52" rx="58" ry="15" fill="none" stroke="#2bf0ff" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.6"/>
              <ellipse id="wave-rear-2" cx="-135" cy="68" rx="38" ry="10" fill="none" stroke="#ff3e9d" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.4"/>
              <ellipse id="wave-front-2" cx="135" cy="68" rx="38" ry="10" fill="none" stroke="#ff3e9d" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.4"/>
            </g>

            <!-- Rear Thruster Housing & Core -->
            <g id="thruster-rear-group" transform="translate(-135, 24)">
              <ellipse cx="0" cy="14" rx="68" ry="22" fill="url(#thrusterGlowGrad)"/>
              <path d="M -52,-8 L 52,-8 L 40,14 L -40,14 Z" fill="#14182e" stroke="#2bf0ff" stroke-width="2"/>
              <ellipse cx="0" cy="12" rx="38" ry="9" fill="#0d1326" stroke="#ff3e9d" stroke-width="2"/>
              <ellipse id="thruster-rear-core" cx="0" cy="12" rx="28" ry="6" fill="#99fcff" filter="url(#neonGlow)"/>
            </g>

            <!-- Front Thruster Housing & Core -->
            <g id="thruster-front-group" transform="translate(135, 24)">
              <ellipse cx="0" cy="14" rx="68" ry="22" fill="url(#thrusterGlowGrad)"/>
              <path d="M -52,-8 L 52,-8 L 40,14 L -40,14 Z" fill="#14182e" stroke="#2bf0ff" stroke-width="2"/>
              <ellipse cx="0" cy="12" rx="38" ry="9" fill="#0d1326" stroke="#ff3e9d" stroke-width="2"/>
              <ellipse id="thruster-front-core" cx="0" cy="12" rx="28" ry="6" fill="#99fcff" filter="url(#neonGlow)"/>
            </g>

            <!-- Underside Hull / Chassis -->
            <path d="M -230,0 C -246,16 -205,30 -150,30 L 155,30 C 210,30 250,14 238,-2 Z"
                  fill="url(#deckBaseGrad)" stroke="#2c355c" stroke-width="2"/>

            <!-- Side Neon Bumper Rail -->
            <path d="M -242,-6 C -255,4 -215,18 -155,18 L 160,18 C 218,18 258,2 244,-8 C 232,-16 190,-12 155,-12 L -155,-12 C -195,-12 -232,-14 -242,-6 Z"
                  fill="url(#deckRimGrad)" filter="url(#neonGlow)"/>

            <!-- Main Deck Top Surface (Isometric Perspective) -->
            <path d="M -236,-8 C -248,-24 -192,-38 -130,-38 L 140,-38 C 202,-38 252,-22 240,-6 C 228,8 182,11 140,11 L -135,11 C -185,11 -225,6 -236,-8 Z"
                  fill="url(#deckTopGrad)" stroke="#ff7ec6" stroke-width="2.5"/>

            <!-- Deck Graphic Stripes & Grip Pads -->
            <path d="M -185,-14 L -120,-30 L -65,-30 L -130,-14 Z" fill="#ff3e9d" opacity="0.85"/>
            <path d="M -105,-14 L -40,-30 L 10,-30 L -55,-14 Z" fill="#ffb84d" opacity="0.85"/>
            <path d="M 35,-30 L 115,-30 L 165,-14 L 85,-14 Z" fill="#2bf0ff" opacity="0.8"/>

            <!-- Rear & Front Grip Footpads -->
            <ellipse cx="-112" cy="-13" rx="52" ry="13" fill="#171a30" stroke="#5cfaff" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="6 4"/>
            <ellipse cx="95" cy="-13" rx="52" ry="13" fill="#171a30" stroke="#5cfaff" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="6 4"/>

            <!-- Side Animated Speed Chevrons -->
            <g id="board-chevrons" transform="translate(0, 4)">
              <polygon class="chev" points="-90,-2 -76,-2 -68,5 -76,12 -90,12 -82,5" fill="#fff3a1"/>
              <polygon class="chev" points="-55,-2 -41,-2 -33,5 -41,12 -55,12 -47,5" fill="#fff3a1"/>
              <polygon class="chev" points="-20,-2 -6,-2 2,5 -6,12 -20,12 -12,5" fill="#fff3a1"/>
              <polygon class="chev" points="15,-2 29,-2 37,5 29,12 15,12 23,5" fill="#fff3a1"/>
              <polygon class="chev" points="50,-2 64,-2 72,5 64,12 50,12 58,5" fill="#fff3a1"/>
            </g>

            <!-- Front Laser Headlight Cone -->
            <polygon id="headlight-cone" points="238,-6 430,-45 430,45" fill="url(#thrusterGlowGrad)" opacity="0.32" style="mix-blend-mode: screen;"/>
            <ellipse cx="236" cy="-5" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#ffffff" filter="url(#neonGlow)"/>
          </g>

          <!-- CAPYBARA CHARACTER GROUP -->
          <g id="capybara-group" transform="translate(-10, 0)">

            <!-- Flowing Scarf Tail (Behind Capybara) -->
            <g id="scarf-back-group">
              <path id="scarf-tail-secondary" d="M 42,-58 C -25,-68 -95,-45 -165,-62 C -205,-72 -245,-55 -275,-68 L -265,-42 C -225,-32 -185,-48 -145,-38 C -85,-22 -20,-42 42,-36 Z"
                    fill="#c9184a"/>
              <path id="scarf-tail-primary" d="M 48,-52 C -20,-58 -95,-30 -168,-44 C -215,-54 -255,-34 -295,-46 L -280,-16 C -235,-8 -195,-26 -148,-16 C -80,-2 -18,-26 48,-24 Z"
                    fill="url(#scarfGrad)" stroke="#ffe082" stroke-width="2"/>
            </g>

            <!-- Far Back Leg (Rear Left) -->
            <g id="leg-rear-far" transform="translate(-128, 12)">
              <path d="M -18,-35 C -30,-5 -28,22 -20,38 C -12,44 10,44 18,38 C 22,22 18,-10 10,-35 Z" fill="#5e3416"/>
              <!-- Webbed Capybara Toes -->
              <ellipse cx="-6" cy="40" rx="18" ry="7" fill="#3b1f0b"/>
              <ellipse cx="8" cy="42" rx="14" ry="6" fill="#2c1607"/>
            </g>

            <!-- Far Front Leg (Front Left) -->
            <g id="leg-front-far" transform="translate(68, 14)">
              <path d="M -14,-36 C -20,-8 -16,20 -10,36 C -2,42 16,42 22,36 C 24,18 18,-12 12,-36 Z" fill="#633718"/>
              <ellipse cx="4" cy="38" rx="17" ry="6.5" fill="#3b1f0b"/>
              <ellipse cx="15" cy="40" rx="13" ry="5.5" fill="#2c1607"/>
            </g>

            <!-- Main Barrel Body -->
            <g id="capy-torso">
              <!-- Stout Potato/Barrel Shape -->
              <path d="M -152,-38
                       C -178,-78 -150,-142 -82,-150
                       C -25,-156 32,-148 76,-142
                       C 118,-136 135,-85 122,-32
                       C 110,12 68,26 -10,26
                       C -92,26 -134,2 -152,-38 Z"
                    fill="url(#capyBodyGrad)" stroke="#593014" stroke-width="3"/>

              <!-- Belly Shadow Shading -->
              <path d="M -146,-28 C -120,16 -65,25 4,25 C 68,25 106,10 119,-28 C 85,-2 35,6 -20,6 C -80,6 -122,-6 -146,-28 Z"
                    fill="url(#capyBellyGrad)"/>

              <!-- Iconic Coarse Capybara Fur Texture Notches & Strokes -->
              <g stroke="#6b3b19" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.65">
                <path d="M -115,-125 Q -98,-130 -85,-124"/>
                <path d="M -70,-134 Q -52,-138 -36,-132"/>
                <path d="M -95,-102 Q -78,-106 -64,-100"/>
                <path d="M -42,-112 Q -22,-115 -8,-109"/>
                <path d="M -132,-88 Q -116,-94 -102,-87"/>
                <path d="M -125,-60 Q -108,-64 -92,-58"/>
                <path d="M -55,-78 Q -36,-82 -20,-75"/>
                <path d="M 8,-96 Q 24,-100 38,-93"/>
              </g>

              <!-- Warm Fur Highlights on Back & Rump -->
              <path d="M -125,-128 C -85,-148 -15,-148 45,-138" fill="none" stroke="#e3a66d" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.5"/>
              <!-- Cute Fluffy Rump Tuft -->
              <path d="M -150,-92 L -164,-98 L -155,-82 L -168,-80 L -154,-68" fill="#a86834" stroke="#593014" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
            </g>

            <!-- Near Back Leg (Rear Right - Planted on Rear Grip Pad) -->
            <g id="leg-rear-near" transform="translate(-94, 14)">
              <path d="M -26,-45 C -38,-18 -34,18 -24,39 C -14,46 14,46 22,39 C 28,20 24,-14 14,-42 Z"
                    fill="url(#capyLegGrad)" stroke="#4a270f" stroke-width="2.5"/>
              <!-- Foot & Webbed Toes -->
              <path d="M -20,35 C -22,46 -4,49 26,46 C 34,44 34,36 20,33 Z" fill="#3d200c" stroke="#261205" stroke-width="2"/>
              <line x1="6" y1="37" x2="14" y2="45" stroke="#241104" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
              <line x1="17" y1="36" x2="25" y2="44" stroke="#241104" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
            </g>

            <!-- Near Front Leg (Front Right - Planted on Front Grip Pad) -->
            <g id="leg-front-near" transform="translate(96, 14)">
              <path d="M -20,-44 C -28,-14 -24,18 -16,39 C -6,45 16,45 24,39 C 28,18 22,-15 14,-42 Z"
                    fill="url(#capyLegGrad)" stroke="#4a270f" stroke-width="2.5"/>
              <path d="M -14,35 C -16,46 2,48 30,45 C 37,43 36,35 22,33 Z" fill="#3d200c" stroke="#261205" stroke-width="2"/>
              <line x1="10" y1="37" x2="18" y2="44" stroke="#241104" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
              <line x1="20" y1="36" x2="28" y2="43" stroke="#241104" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
            </g>

            <!-- Little Duckling / Bird Buddy Chilling on Capybara's Rump! -->
            <g id="bird-buddy" transform="translate(-112, -148)">
              <!-- Duckling Body -->
              <path d="M -18,6 C -22,-6 -12,-16 0,-15 C 8,-15 14,-22 22,-20 C 29,-18 30,-8 25,0 C 22,8 10,12 -4,12 C -13,12 -16,10 -18,6 Z"
                    fill="#ffe14d" stroke="#8c5808" stroke-width="2"/>
              <!-- Wing -->
              <path d="M -4,-5 C 4,-8 12,-3 10,4 C 4,6 -4,4 -4,-5 Z" fill="#ffc419" stroke="#b37400" stroke-width="1.5"/>
              <!-- Tiny Beak -->
              <path d="M 27,-13 L 36,-10 L 27,-7 Z" fill="#ff7326" stroke="#8c3100" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
              <!-- Chill Eye -->
              <circle cx="21" cy="-12" r="2" fill="#2b1605"/>
              <!-- Tiny Aviator Goggles Strap -->
              <line x1="14" y1="-16" x2="26" y2="-13" stroke="#2bf0ff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
            </g>

            <!-- Scarf Collar Wrapping Neck -->
            <g id="scarf-collar">
              <path d="M 32,-128 C 42,-82 68,-45 112,-32 C 126,-28 134,-44 126,-56 C 95,-72 72,-102 64,-136 Z"
                    fill="url(#scarfGrad)" stroke="#6e1423" stroke-width="2.5"/>
              <!-- Gold Stripe on Scarf Collar -->
              <path d="M 46,-122 C 56,-84 82,-54 118,-42" fill="none" stroke="#ffe082" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
            </g>

            <!-- CAPYBARA HEAD & ICONIC BOXY SNOUT -->
            <g id="capy-head" transform="translate(86, -138)">
              <!-- Far Ear (Left) -->
              <g id="ear-far" transform="translate(18, -56)">
                <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="12" ry="16" transform="rotate(-18)" fill="#6e3d19" stroke="#3d1f0a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
                <ellipse cx="1" cy="2" rx="6" ry="9" transform="rotate(-18)" fill="#42210b"/>
              </g>

              <!-- Head Base & Blunt Rectangular Capybara Snout -->
              <path d="M -42,-36
                       C -34,-62 2,-68 42,-64
                       C 78,-60 116,-48 138,-38
                       C 154,-30 160,-10 156,16
                       C 152,40 136,52 108,52
                       C 72,52 44,44 14,42
                       C -22,40 -46,16 -42,-36 Z"
                    fill="url(#capyHeadGrad)" stroke="#522b10" stroke-width="3"/>

              <!-- Characteristic Dark Blunt Muzzle / Nose Patch -->
              <path d="M 98,-43
                       C 122,-42 144,-34 153,-20
                       C 160,-6 158,22 148,38
                       C 138,50 116,52 96,49
                       C 82,46 78,24 80,-2
                       C 82,-24 86,-42 98,-43 Z"
                    fill="url(#capySnoutGrad)"/>

              <!-- Crown Highlight -->

<script>
(() => {
  // DOM Elements
  const worldCanvas = document.getElementById('world-canvas');
  const wCtx = worldCanvas.getContext('2d');
  const fxCanvas = document.getElementById('fx-canvas');
  const fCtx = fxCanvas.getContext('2d');

  const rigRoot = document.getElementById('rig-root');
  const hoverboardGroup = document.getElementById('hoverboard-group');
  const capybaraGroup = document.getElementById('capybara-group');
  const capyHead = document.getElementById('capy-head');
  const yuzuHat = document.getElementById('yuzu-hat');
  const birdBuddy = document.getElementById('bird-buddy');
  const earNear = document.getElementById('ear-near');
  const earFar = document.getElementById('ear-far');
  const scarfPrimary = document.getElementById('scarf-tail-primary');
  const scarfSecondary = document.getElementById('scarf-tail-secondary');
  const upperEyelid = document.getElementById('upper-eyelid');
  const eyelidLine = document.getElementById('eyelid-line');
  const cyberShades = document.getElementById('cyber-shades');
  const capyBlush = document.getElementById('capy-blush');
  const waveRear = document.getElementById('wave-rear');
  const waveFront = document.getElementById('wave-front');
  const waveRear2 = document.getElementById('wave-rear-2');
  const waveFront2 = document.getElementById('wave-front-2');
  const chevrons = document.querySelectorAll('#board-chevrons .chev');
  const thrusterRearCore = document.getElementById('thruster-rear-core');
  const thrusterFrontCore = document.getElementById('thruster-front-core');

  const speedReadout = document.getElementById('speed-readout');
  const yuzuReadout = document.getElementById('yuzu-readout');
  const chillReadout = document.getElementById('chill-readout');

  const btnTrick = document.getElementById('btn-trick');
  const btnBoost = document.getElementById('btn-boost');
  const btnShades = document.getElementById('btn-shades');
  const btnSnack = document.getElementById('btn-snack');
  const btnTheme = document.getElementById('btn-theme');
  const themeLabel = document.getElementById('theme-label');

  // Themes Configuration
  const THEMES = [
    {
      name: 'Sunset Cruise',
      icon: '🌅',
      skyTop: '#160836',
      skyMid: '#6b1d5c',
      skyBot: '#ff7b47',
      sunTop: '#fff394',
      sunBot: '#ff2975',
      mountainFar: '#2d114d',
      mountainNear: '#190830',
      roadFill: '#120726',
      gridColor: 'rgba(255, 77, 166, 0.48)',
      curbGlow: '#00f6ff',
      thrusterA: '#00f6ff',
      thrusterB: '#ff2e93'
    },
    {
      name: 'Neon Night',
      icon: '🌃',
      skyTop: '#040614',
      skyMid: '#0d1b3e',
      skyBot: '#1b3b6f',
      sunTop: '#70f8ff',
      sunBot: '#5c27fe',
      mountainFar: '#0c1633',
      mountainNear: '#060b1c',
      roadFill: '#050814',
      gridColor: 'rgba(0, 246, 255, 0.42)',
      curbGlow: '#ff2e93',
      thrusterA: '#5cfaff',
      thrusterB: '#9d4edd'
    },
    {
      name: 'Matcha Springs',
      icon: '🎋',
      skyTop: '#132a2e',
      skyMid: '#2e6f65',
      skyBot: '#f4d58d',
      sunTop: '#fff9db',
      sunBot: '#ff9f68',
      mountainFar: '#1f4742',
      mountainNear: '#112926',
      roadFill: '#0e1f1d',
      gridColor: 'rgba(136, 242, 184, 0.42)',
      curbGlow: '#ffe066',
      thrusterA: '#72efdd',
      thrusterB: '#ff9f1c'
    }
  ];

  // Scene State
  let width = window.innerWidth;
  let height = window.innerHeight;
  let dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);

  let state = {
    time: 0,
    themeIndex: 0,
    boost: false,
    shadesOn: true,
    speed: 1,
    targetSpeed: 1,
    roadScroll: 0,
    yuzuCount: 12,
    chillScore: 100,

    // Pointer tracking (-1 to 1)
    pointerX: 0,
    pointerY: 0,
    smoothX: 0,
    smoothY: 0,
    lastPointerMove: 0,

    // Trick / Jump state
    trickActive: false,
    trickProgress: 0,
    trickType: 0,

    // Blink & ear twitch timers
    blinkTimer: 2.4,
    isBlinking: false,
    earTwitchTimer: 1.8,
    earTwitchAmount: 0,
    chewPhase: 0
  };

  // World Arrays
  const stars = [];
  const clouds = [];
  const skyline = [];
  const thrusterParticles = [];
  const sparkParticles = [];
  const floatingTexts = [];
  const roadSnacks = [];
  const speedLines = [];

  function initWorldObjects() {
    stars.length = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 85; i++) {
      stars.push({
        x: Math.random(),
        y: Math.random() * 0.52,
        r: Math.random() * 2 + 0.6,
        phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
      });
    }

    clouds.length = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      clouds.push({
        x: Math.random() * 1.4 - 0.2,
        y: 0.12 + Math.random() * 0.3,
        w: 140 + Math.random() * 180,
        h: 22 + Math.random() * 24,
        speed: 0.015 + Math.random() * 0.025
      });
    }

    skyline.length = 0;
    let cx = 0;
    while (cx < 2000) {
      const bw = 35 + Math.random() * 65;
      const bh = 30 + Math.random() * 115;
      skyline.push({ x: cx, w: bw, h: bh, windows: Math.floor(Math.random() * 4) + 2 });
      cx += bw + 6;
    }

    speedLines.length = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
      speedLines.push({
        x: Math.random() * width,
        y: Math.random() * height,
        len: 80 + Math.random() * 180,
        speed: 18 + Math.random() * 16,
        alpha: 0.15 + Math.random() * 0.35
      });
    }

    // Spawn initial floating yuzu snacks on the highway
    roadSnacks.length = 0;
    spawnRoadSnack(width * 0.85);
    spawnRoadSnack(width * 1.35);
  }

  function spawnRoadSnack(customX) {
    const laneOffset = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 90;
    roadSnacks.push({
      x: customX !== undefined ? customX : width + 120,
      laneOffset,
      bobPhase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      collected: false,
      scale: 1
    });
  }

  function resize() {
    width = window.innerWidth;
    height = window.innerHeight;
    dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);

    worldCanvas.width = width * dpr;
    worldCanvas.height = height * dpr;
    wCtx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

    fxCanvas.width = width * dpr;
    fxCanvas.height = height * dpr;
    fCtx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  }

  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();
  initWorldObjects();

  // Actions & Controls
  function triggerTrick() {
    if (state.trickActive) return;
    state.trickActive = true;
    state.trickProgress = 0;
    state.trickType = (state.trickType + 1) % 2;
    state.chillScore += 25;
    chillReadout.textContent = `${state.chillScore}%`;

    // Burst of celebratory stars around the board
    const cx = width * 0.5 + state.smoothX * 95;
    const cy = height * 0.54 + state.smoothY * 35;
    for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
      const angle = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / 28 + Math.random() * 0.2;
      const spd = 3 + Math.random() * 7;
      sparkParticles.push({
        x: cx,
        y: cy + 30,
        vx: Math.cos(angle) * spd,
        vy: Math.sin(angle) * spd - 2,
        size: 4 + Math.random() * 5,
        color: i % 2 === 0 ? '#ffe066' : '#00f6ff',
        life: 1,
        decay: 0.02 + Math.random() * 0.015,
        star: true
      });
    }

    floatingTexts.push({
      text: state.trickType === 0 ? '360° YUZU FLIP! +25 CHILL' : 'CAPY BARREL ROLL! +25 CHILL',
      x: cx,
      y: cy - 110,
      vy: -1.6,
      life: 1
    });
  }

  function toggleBoost(forceState) {
    state.boost = typeof forceState === 'boolean' ? forceState : !state.boost;
    state.targetSpeed = state.boost ? 2.25 : 1.0;
    btnBoost.classList.toggle('active', state.boost);
  }

  function toggleShades() {
    state.shadesOn = !state.shadesOn;
    cyberShades.style.transition = 'opacity 0.25s ease, transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)';
    if (state.shadesOn) {
      cyberShades.style.opacity = '1';
      cyberShades.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(52, -24) scale(1)');
    } else {
      cyberShades.style.opacity = '0';
      cyberShades.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(65, -44) scale(0.7)');
    }
    btnShades.classList.toggle('active', state.shadesOn);
  }

  function cycleTheme() {
    state.themeIndex = (state.themeIndex + 1) % THEMES.length;
    const t = THEMES[state.themeIndex];
    themeLabel.textContent = `${t.icon} Theme: ${t.name}`;
  }

  function tossSnack() {
    spawnRoadSnack(width + 60);
    const cx = width * 0.5 + state.smoothX * 95;
    const cy = height * 0.5 + state.smoothY * 35;
    floatingTexts.push({
      text: '🍊 YUZU INCOMING!',
      x: cx + 120,
      y: cy - 60,
      vy: -1.3,
      life: 1
    });
  }

  // Event Listeners
  btnTrick.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); triggerTrick(); });
  btnBoost.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); toggleBoost(); });
  btnShades.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); toggleShades(); });
  btnSnack.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); tossSnack(); });
  btnTheme.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); cycleTheme(); });

  window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
    state.pointerX = (e.clientX / width) * 2 - 1;
    state.pointerY = (e.clientY / height) * 2 - 1;
    state.lastPointerMove = performance.now();
  });

  document.getElementById('scene-container').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (e.target.closest('.hud-bottom') || e.target.closest('.hud-top')) return;
    triggerTrick();
  });

  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.code === 'Space') {
      e.preventDefault();
      triggerTrick();
    } else if (e.key === 'b' || e.key === 'B' || e.key === 'Shift') {
      toggleBoost();
    } else if (e.key === 'v' || e.key === 'V') {
      toggleShades();
    } else if (e.key === 'y' || e.key === 'Y') {
      tossSnack();
    } else if (e.key === 't' || e.key === 'T') {
      cycleTheme();
    }
  });

  // Draw Background & Parallax World on worldCanvas
  function drawWorld(dt) {
    const theme = THEMES[state.themeIndex];
    const horizonY = height * 0.62;

    // 1. Sky Gradient
    const skyGrad = wCtx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, horizonY);
    skyGrad.addColorStop(0, theme.skyTop);
    skyGrad.addColorStop(0.55, theme.skyMid);
    skyGrad.addColorStop(1, theme.skyBot);
    wCtx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
    wCtx.fillRect(0, 0, width, horizonY + 2);

    // 2. Twinkling Stars
    for (let i = 0; i < stars.length; i++) {
      const s = stars[i];
      const twinkle = 0.35 + 0.65 * Math.sin(state.time * 2.5 + s.phase);
      wCtx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 250, 235, ${twinkle * 0.85})`;
      wCtx.beginPath();
      wCtx.arc(s.x * width, s.y * height, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      wCtx.fill();
    }

    // 3. Giant Synthwave Sun / Moon with Retro Scanline Cutouts
    const sunRadius = Math.min(width, height) * 0.21;
    const sunX = width * 0.5 - state.smoothX * 22;
    const sunY = horizonY - sunRadius * 0.52;

    wCtx.save();
    const sunGlow = wCtx.createRadialGradient(sunX, sunY, sunRadius * 0.2, sunX, sunY, sunRadius * 1.65);
    sunGlow.addColorStop(0, theme.sunTop);
    sunGlow.addColorStop(0.5, theme.sunBot);
    sunGlow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    wCtx.fillStyle = sunGlow;
    wCtx.globalAlpha = 0.45;
    wCtx.beginPath();
    wCtx.arc(sunX, sunY, sunRadius * 1.65, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    wCtx.fill();
    wCtx.globalAlpha = 1;

    // Sun body clipped with horizontal retro bands
    wCtx.beginPath();
    for (let bandY = sunY - sunRadius; bandY < sunY + sunRadius; bandY += 14) {
      const rel = (bandY - sunY) / sunRadius;
      const gap = rel > 0.05 ? Math.min(9, (rel + 0.1) * 9) : 0;
      wCtx.rect(sunX - sunRadius - 10, bandY, sunRadius * 2 + 20, 14 - gap);
    }
    wCtx.clip();

    const sunFill = wCtx.createLinearGradient(sunX, sunY - sunRadius, sunX, sunY + sunRadius);
    sunFill.addColorStop(0, theme.sunTop);
    sunFill.addColorStop(1, theme.sunBot);
    wCtx.fillStyle = sunFill;
    wCtx.beginPath();
    wCtx.arc(sunX, sunY, sunRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    wCtx.fill();
    wCtx.restore();

    // 4. Soft Drifting Clouds
    wCtx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 215, 195, 0.14)';
    for (const c of clouds) {
      c.x -= c.speed * state.speed * dt * 0.5;
      if (c.x < -0.3) c.x = 1.25;
      const cx = c.x * width;
      const cy = c.y * height;
      wCtx.beginPath();
      wCtx.roundRect(cx, cy, c.w, c.h, c.h * 0.5);
      wCtx.fill();
    }

    // 5. Distant Mountain Range & Parallax Skyline
    drawMountains(horizonY, 0.18, 95, theme.mountainFar, 1.1);
    drawSkyline(horizonY, theme);
    drawMountains(horizonY, 0.42, 52, theme.mountainNear, 2.3);

    // 6. Highway Ground Plane & Perspective Neon Grid
    const roadGrad = wCtx.createLinearGradient(0, horizonY, 0, height);
    roadGrad.addColorStop(0, theme.roadFill);
    roadGrad.addColorStop(1, '#04020a');
    wCtx.fillStyle = roadGrad;
    wCtx.fillRect(0, horizonY, width, height - horizonY);

    // Horizon Neon Curb Line
    wCtx.save();
    wCtx.strokeStyle = theme.curbGlow;
    wCtx.shadowColor = theme.curbGlow;
    wCtx.shadowBlur = 16;
    wCtx.lineWidth = 3;
    wCtx.beginPath();
    wCtx.moveTo(0, horizonY);
    wCtx.lineTo(width, horizonY);
    wCtx.stroke();
    wCtx.restore();

    // Perspective Grid Lines
    wCtx.save();
    wCtx.strokeStyle = theme.gridColor;
    wCtx.lineWidth = 1.6;
    const vanishX = width * 0.5 - state.smoothX * 60;
    const roadH = height - horizonY;

    // Radial perspective lines
    for (let i = -12; i <= 12; i++) {
      wCtx.beginPath();
      wCtx.moveTo(vanishX + i * 28, horizonY);
      wCtx.lineTo(vanishX + i * 195, height);
      wCtx.stroke();
    }

    // Scrolling vertical/transverse grid lines
    state.roadScroll = (state.roadScroll + dt * 380 * state.speed) % 60;
    for (let d = 1; d <= 16; d++) {
      const norm = ((d * 60 - state.roadScroll) / (16 * 60));
      if (norm <= 0) continue;
      // Exponential depth curve for realistic perspective speed
      const y = horizonY + Math.pow(norm, 2.15) * roadH;
      wCtx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, norm * 1.4);
      wCtx.beginPath();
      wCtx.moveTo(0, y);
      wCtx.lineTo(width, y);
      wCtx.stroke();
    }
    wCtx.restore();

    // 7. Ground Anti-Gravity Shadow & Neon Reflection directly under Hoverboard
    const rigX = width * 0.5 + state.smoothX * 95;
    const groundY = horizonY + (height - horizonY) * 0.44 + state.smoothY * 28;
    const jumpHeight = state.trickActive ? Math.sin(state.trickProgress * Math.PI) * 145 : 0;
    const shadowScale = Math.max(0.45, 1 - jumpHeight / 280);

    wCtx.save();
    // Dark contact shadow
    wCtx.fillStyle = 'rgba(3, 1, 10, 0.68)';
    wCtx.beginPath();
    wCtx.ellipse(rigX, groundY, 215 * shadowScale, 28 * shadowScale, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    wCtx.fill();

    // Neon plasma reflection on asphalt
    const reflGrad = wCtx.createRadialGradient(rigX, groundY, 10, rigX, groundY, 210 * shadowScale);
    reflGrad.addColorStop(0, state.boost ? 'rgba(255, 46, 147, 0.65)' : 'rgba(0, 246, 255, 0.55)');
    reflGrad.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(255, 62, 157, 0.25)');
    reflGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    wCtx.fillStyle = reflGrad;
    wCtx.beginPath();
    wCtx.ellipse(rigX, groundY, 230 * shadowScale, 36 * shadowScale, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    wCtx.fill();
    wCtx.restore();

    // 8. Collectible Floating Yuzus on Road
    updateAndDrawRoadSnacks(dt, rigX, groundY);
  }

  function drawMountains(horizonY, speedFactor, maxH, color, freq) {
    const scroll = state.time * 90 * speedFactor * state.speed;
    wCtx.fillStyle = color;
    wCtx.beginPath();
    wCtx.moveTo(0, horizonY);
    const step = 32;
    for (let x = 0; x <= width + step; x += step) {
      const wx = x + scroll;
      const h =
        Math.sin(wx * 0.0035 * freq) * (maxH * 0.55) +
        Math.cos(wx * 0.008 * freq) * (maxH * 0.35) +
        maxH * 0.6;
      wCtx.lineTo(x, horizonY - Math.max(8, h));
    }
    wCtx.lineTo(width, horizonY);
    wCtx.closePath();
    wCtx.fill();
  }

  function drawSkyline(horizonY, theme) {
    const scroll = (state.time * 48 * state.speed) % 2000;
    wCtx.save();
    wCtx.fillStyle = theme.mountainNear;
    for (const b of skyline) {
      let bx = (b.x - scroll) % 2000;
      if (bx < -120) bx += 2000;
      if (bx > width + 100) continue;
      wCtx.fillRect(bx, horizonY - b.h, b.w, b.h);

      // Glowing cyber windows
      wCtx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 214, 112, 0.28)';
      for (let wy = horizonY - b.h + 10; wy < horizonY - 12; wy += 14) {
        wCtx.fillRect(bx + 7, wy, b.w - 14, 4);
      }
      wCtx.fillStyle = theme.mountainNear;
    }
    wCtx.restore();
  }

  function updateAndDrawRoadSnacks(dt, capyX, capyGroundY) {
    for (let i = roadSnacks.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const s = roadSnacks[i];
      s.x -= dt * 390 * state.speed;
      s.bobPhase += dt * 5;

      const sy = capyGroundY - 52 + s.laneOffset * 0.45 + Math.sin(s.bobPhase) * 9;

      // Check pickup distance with Capybara
      const dx = s.x - (capyX + 95);
      const dy = sy - (capyGroundY - 55);
      if (!s.collected && Math.hypot(dx, dy) < 95) {
        s.collected = true;
        state.yuzuCount += 1;
        state.chillScore += 10;
        yuzuReadout.textContent = `🍊 ${state.yuzuCount}`;
        chillReadout.textContent = `${state.chillScore}%`;
        state.chewPhase = 1.2; // Happy munching animation!

        floatingTexts.push({
          text: '+1 YUZU! MUNCH~',
          x: s.x,
          y: sy - 25,
          vy: -1.8,
          life: 1
        });

        for (let k = 0; k < 14; k++) {
          const ang = (Math.PI * 2 * k) / 14;
          sparkParticles.push({
            x: s.x,
            y: sy,
            vx: Math.cos(ang) * 4.5,
            vy: Math.sin(ang) * 4.5,
            size: 4.5,
            color: '#ffd147',
            life: 1,
            decay: 0.035,
            star: true
          });
        }
      }

      if (s.collected) {
        s.scale -= dt * 6;
      }

      if (s.x < -80 || s.scale <= 0) {
        roadSnacks.splice(i, 1);
        if (roadSnacks.length < 2) {
          spawnRoadSnack(width + 250 + Math.random() * 450);
        }
        continue;
      }

      // Draw glowing collectible Yuzu on road
      wCtx.save();
      wCtx.translate(s.x, sy);
      wCtx.scale(s.scale, s.scale);

      // Aura
      wCtx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 212, 71, 0.28)';
      wCtx.beginPath();
      wCtx.arc(0, 0, 26, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      wCtx.fill();

      // Yuzu fruit
      wCtx.fillStyle = '#ffbe2e';
      wCtx.strokeStyle = '#6e3800';
      wCtx.lineWidth = 2.2;
      wCtx.beginPath();
      wCtx.ellipse(0, 0, 16, 13, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      wCtx.fill();
      wCtx.stroke();

      // Green leaf
      wCtx.fillStyle = '#38d962';
      wCtx.beginPath();
      wCtx.ellipse(5, -13, 7, 4, -0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      wCtx.fill();
      wCtx.restore();
    }
  }

  // Update Capybara & Hoverboard Articulated SVG Rig
  function updateCapybaraRig(dt) {
    // Autonomous gentle weaving if user hasn't moved mouse recently
    if (performance.now() - state.lastPointerMove > 2600) {
      state.pointerX = Math.sin(state.time * 0.75) * 0.42;
      state.pointerY = Math.cos(state.time * 1.1) * 0.25;
    }

    state.smoothX += (state.pointerX - state.smoothX) * Math.min(1, dt * 6);
    state.smoothY += (state.pointerY - state.smoothY) * Math.min(1, dt * 6);
    state.speed += (state.targetSpeed - state.speed) * Math.min(1, dt * 4);

    // Update Speedometer Readout
    const mph = Math.round(88 * state.speed + Math.sin(state.time * 7) * 2);
    speedReadout.textContent = `${mph} MPH`;

    // Harmonic Hover Oscillation
    const hoverBob = Math.sin(state.time * 4.4) * 11 + Math.cos(state.time * 8.8) * 2.5;
    const carveTilt = state.smoothX * 9 + Math.cos(state.time * 4.4) * 2.4 - (state.boost ? 4.5 : 0);

    // Trick / Jump Calculation
    let jumpY = 0;
    let trickRotation = 0;
    let yuzuPopY = 0;
    let yuzuRot = 0;
    let birdPopY = 0;

    if (state.trickActive) {
      state.trickProgress += dt * 1.55;
      if (state.trickProgress >= 1) {
        state.trickActive = false;
        state.trickProgress = 0;
      } else {
        const p = state.trickProgress;
        jumpY = -Math.sin(p * Math.PI) * 135;
        // Smooth ease-in-out 360 spin
        const ease = p < 0.5 ? 2 * p * p : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * p + 2, 2) / 2;
        trickRotation = ease * 360 * (state.trickType === 0 ? -1 : 1);
        // Yuzu and bird float slightly higher during peak of flip!
        yuzuPopY = -Math.sin(p * Math.PI) * 36;
        yuzuRot = ease * 360;
        birdPopY = -Math.sin(p * Math.PI) * 28;
      }
    }

    // Position the entire wrapper slightly with pointer
    const wrapper = document.getElementById('capy-rig-wrapper');
    const offsetX = state.smoothX * 95;
    const offsetY = state.smoothY * 32;
    wrapper.style.transform = `translate3d(${offsetX.toFixed(1)}px, ${offsetY.toFixed(1)}px, 0)`;

    // Apply Hover & Trick Transform to SVG Root
    const totalY = 300 + hoverBob + jumpY;
    const totalRot = carveTilt + trickRotation;
    rigRoot.setAttribute('transform', `translate(350, ${totalY.toFixed(2)}) rotate(${totalRot.toFixed(2)})`);

    // Subtle suspension compression between Capybara and Hoverboard
    const kneeFlex = Math.sin(state.time * 4.4 - 0.5) * 3.5;
    capybaraGroup.setAttribute('transform', `translate(-10, ${kneeFlex.toFixed(2)})`);

    // Head bob, chew animation & serene nod
    let headPitch = Math.sin(state.time * 4.4 + 0.6) * 2.2 + (state.boost ? 3.5 : 0);
    if (state.chewPhase > 0) {
      state.chewPhase = Math.max(0, state.chewPhase - dt);
      headPitch += Math.sin(state.time * 28) * 3.2;
      capyBlush.setAttribute('opacity', '0.68');
    } else {
      capyBlush.setAttribute('opacity', '0.32');
    }
    capyHead.setAttribute('transform', `translate(86, ${(-138 + kneeFlex * 0.4).toFixed(2)}) rotate(${headPitch.toFixed(2)})`);

    // Yuzu Hat balance physics
    const yuzuWobble = Math.sin(state.time * 5.5) * 4 + yuzuRot;
    const yuzuBob = Math.abs(Math.cos(state.time * 4.4)) * -3 + yuzuPopY;
    yuzuHat.setAttribute('transform', `translate(32, ${(-74 + yuzuBob).toFixed(2)}) rotate(${yuzuWobble.toFixed(2)})`);

    // Bird Buddy physics on rump
    const birdBob = Math.sin(state.time * 6.2 + 1) * 3 + birdPopY;
    const birdTilt = Math.cos(state.time * 5) * 5;
    birdBuddy.setAttribute('transform', `translate(-112, ${(-148 + birdBob).toFixed(2)}) rotate(${birdTilt.toFixed(2)})`);

    // Procedural Wind-Whipped Scarf Path Morphing
    const windFreq = state.time * (state.boost ? 18 : 11);
    const w1 = Math.sin(windFreq) * (state.boost ? 22 : 13);
    const w2 = Math.cos(windFreq - 1.3) * (state.boost ? 32 : 18);
    const w3 = Math.sin(windFreq - 2.4) * (state.boost ? 26 : 15);

    scarfPrimary.setAttribute(
      'd',
      `M 48,-52 C -20,${(-58 + w1).toFixed(1)} -95,${(-30 + w2).toFixed(1)} -168,${(-44 - w1).toFixed(1)} ` +
      `C -215,${(-54 + w3).toFixed(1)} -255,${(-34 + w2).toFixed(1)} -298,${(-46 + w3).toFixed(1)} ` +
      `L -282,${(-14 + w3).toFixed(1)} ` +
      `C -235,${(-6 + w2).toFixed(1)} -195,${(-26 - w1).toFixed(1)} -148,${(-16 + w2).toFixed(1)} ` +
      `C -80,${(-2 + w1).toFixed(1)} -18,-26 48,-24 Z`
    );

    scarfSecondary.setAttribute(
      'd',
      `M 42,-58 C -25,${(-68 - w1).toFixed(1)} -95,${(-45 + w3).toFixed(1)} -165,${(-62 + w2).toFixed(1)} ` +
      `C -205,${(-72 - w2).toFixed(1)} -245,${(-55 + w1).toFixed(1)} -278,${(-68 - w3).toFixed(1)} ` +
      `L -265,${(-40 - w3).toFixed(1)} ` +
      `C -225,${(-32 + w1).toFixed(1)} -185,${(-48 - w2).toFixed(1)} -145,${(-38 + w3).toFixed(1)} ` +
      `C -85,-22 -20,-42 42,-36 Z`
    );

    // Periodic Chill Blinking
    state.blinkTimer -= dt;
    if (state.blinkTimer <= 0) {
      if (!state.isBlinking) {
        state.isBlinking = true;
        state.blinkTimer = 0.16; // Duration of closed eye
        upperEyelid.setAttribute('d', 'M -14,7 Q 0,10 14,7 L 14,-11 L -14,-11 Z');
        eyelidLine.setAttribute('d', 'M -14,5 Q 1,9 15,5');
      } else {
        state.isBlinking = false;
        state.blinkTimer = 2.6 + Math.random() * 3.2;
        upperEyelid.setAttribute('d', 'M -14,-3 Q 0,-9 14,-2 L 14,-11 L -14,-11 Z');
        eyelidLine.setAttribute('d', 'M -14,-2 Q 1,-7 15,-1');
      }
    }

    // Periodic Cute Ear Flick
    state.earTwitchTimer -= dt;
    if (state.earTwitchTimer <= 0) {
      state.earTwitchAmount = 1;
      state.earTwitchTimer = 1.8 + Math.random() * 2.8;
    }
    if (state.earTwitchAmount > 0) {
      state.earTwitchAmount = Math.max(0, state.earTwitchAmount - dt * 6);
    }
    const earAngle = -Math.sin(state.earTwitchAmount * Math.PI * 2) * 18 - (state.boost ? 14 : 0);
    earNear.setAttribute('transform', `translate(-14, -52) rotate(${earAngle.toFixed(1)})`);
    earFar.setAttribute('transform', `translate(18, -56) rotate(${(earAngle * 0.7).toFixed(1)})`);

    // Hoverboard Anti-Gravity Repulsor Rings Pulse
    const pulse1 = (state.time * 2.2) % 1;
    const pulse2 = (state.time * 2.2 + 0.5) % 1;

    waveRear.setAttribute('rx', (32 + pulse1 * 42).toFixed(1));
    waveRear.setAttribute('ry', (8 + pulse1 * 11).toFixed(1));
    waveRear.setAttribute('cy', (38 + pulse1 * 28).toFixed(1));
    waveRear.setAttribute('opacity', ((1 - pulse1) * 0.75).toFixed(2));

    waveFront.setAttribute('rx', (32 + pulse1 * 42).toFixed(1));
    waveFront.setAttribute('ry', (8 + pulse1 * 11).toFixed(1));
    waveFront.setAttribute('cy', (38 + pulse1 * 28).toFixed(1));
    waveFront.setAttribute('opacity', ((1 - pulse1) * 0.75).toFixed(2));

    waveRear2.setAttribute('rx', (32 + pulse2 * 42).toFixed(1));
    waveRear2.setAttribute('ry', (8 + pulse2 * 11).toFixed(1));
    waveRear2.setAttribute('cy', (38 + pulse2 * 28).toFixed(1));
    waveRear2.setAttribute('opacity', ((1 - pulse2) * 0.65).toFixed(2));

    waveFront2.setAttribute('rx', (32 + pulse2 * 42).toFixed(1));
    waveFront2.setAttribute('ry', (8 + pulse2 * 11).toFixed(1));
    waveFront2.setAttribute('cy', (38 + pulse2 * 28).toFixed(1));
    waveFront2.setAttribute('opacity', ((1 - pulse2) * 0.65).toFixed(2));

    // Animated Sequential Side Chevrons
    const activeChev = Math.floor(state.time * 10 * state.speed) % chevrons.length;
    chevrons.forEach((el, idx) => {
      const dist = (idx - activeChev + chevrons.length) % chevrons.length;
      el.setAttribute('fill', dist === 0 ? '#00f6ff' : dist === 1 ? '#ff3e9d' : '#fff3a1');
      el.setAttribute('opacity', dist <= 1 ? '1' : '0.45');
    });
  }

  // Foreground FX Canvas: Thruster Plasma Jet, Sparks & Speed Lines
  function updateAndDrawFX(dt) {
    fCtx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
    const theme = THEMES[state.themeIndex];

    // Get exact screen coordinates of Hoverboard thrusters for pixel-locked exhaust
    const rearRect = thrusterRearCore.getBoundingClientRect();
    const frontRect = thrusterFrontCore.getBoundingClientRect();

    const emitPoints = [
      { x: rearRect.left + rearRect.width * 0.5, y: rearRect.top + rearRect.height * 0.5, main: true },
      { x: frontRect.left + frontRect.width * 0.5, y: frontRect.top + frontRect.height * 0.5, main: false }
    ];

    // Spawn new plasma exhaust particles
    const countPerFrame = state.boost ? 5 : 3;
    for (const pt of emitPoints) {
      for (let i = 0; i < countPerFrame; i++) {
        thrusterParticles.push({
          x: pt.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 26,
          y: pt.y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8,
          vx: -(6 + Math.random() * 7) * state.speed,
          vy: (Math.random() - 0.35) * 2.2,
          r: (pt.main ? 10 : 7) + Math.random() * 8,
          color: Math.random() > 0.38 ? theme.thrusterA : theme.thrusterB,
          life: 1,
          decay: 0.032 + Math.random() * 0.025
        });
      }
    }

    // Render plasma trail with additive glow
    fCtx.save();
    fCtx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
    for (let i = thrusterParticles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = thrusterParticles[i];
      p.x += p.vx * dt * 60;
      p.y += p.vy * dt * 60;
      p.life -= p.decay * dt * 60;

      if (p.life <= 0) {
        thrusterParticles.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }

      const radius = Math.max(1, p.r * p.life);
      const grad = fCtx.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, radius * 1.6);
      grad.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
      grad.addColorStop(0.35, p.color);
      grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');

      fCtx.fillStyle = grad;
      fCtx.globalAlpha = p.life * 0.85;
      fCtx.beginPath();
      fCtx.arc(p.x, p.y, radius * 1.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      fCtx.fill();
    }
    fCtx.restore();

    // Render Trick & Snack Star Particles
    for (let i = sparkParticles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const s = sparkParticles[i];
      s.x += s.vx * dt * 60;
      s.y += s.vy * dt * 60;
      s.vy += 0.12 * dt * 60;
      s.life -= s.decay * dt * 60;

      if (s.life <= 0) {
        sparkParticles.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }

      fCtx.save();
      fCtx.translate(s.x, s.y);
      fCtx.rotate(state.time * 6 + i);
      fCtx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, s.life);
      fCtx.fillStyle = s.color;
      drawStar(fCtx, 0, 0, 4, s.size, s.size * 0.42);
      fCtx.restore();
    }

    // Render Hyper-Boost Anime Speed Lines
    if (state.speed > 1.25) {
      const boostAlpha = Math.min(1, (state.speed - 1.2) * 0.9);
      fCtx.save();
      fCtx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
      fCtx.lineWidth = 2;
      for (const sl of speedLines) {
        sl.x -= sl.speed * state.speed * dt * 60;
        if (sl.x + sl.len < 0) {
          sl.x = width + Math.random() * 200;
          sl.y = Math.random() * height;
        }
        fCtx.globalAlpha = sl.alpha * boostAlpha;
        fCtx.beginPath();
        fCtx.moveTo(sl.x, sl.y);
        fCtx.lineTo(sl.x + sl.len, sl.y);
        fCtx.stroke();
      }
      fCtx.restore();
    }

    // Render Floating Score Popups
    for (let i = floatingTexts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const ft = floatingTexts[i];
      ft.y += ft.vy * dt * 60;
      ft.life -= 0.018 * dt * 60;
      if (ft.life <= 0) {
        floatingTexts.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }
      fCtx.save();
      fCtx.font = '800 18px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
      fCtx.textAlign = 'center';
      fCtx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, ft.life * 1.4);
      fCtx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8)';
      fCtx.shadowBlur = 8;
      fCtx.fillStyle = '#ffe373';
      fCtx.fillText(ft.text, ft.x, ft.y);
      fCtx.restore();
    }
  }

  function drawStar(ctx, cx, cy, spikes, outerR, innerR) {
    let rot = (Math.PI / 2) * 3;
    let x = cx;
    let y = cy;
    const step = Math.PI / spikes;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, cy - outerR);
    for (let i = 0; i < spikes; i++) {
      x = cx + Math.cos(rot) * outerR;
      y = cy + Math.sin(rot) * outerR;
      ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      rot += step;

      x = cx + Math.cos(rot) * innerR;
      y = cy + Math.sin(rot) * innerR;
      ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      rot += step;
    }
    ctx.lineTo(cx, cy - outerR);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Main 60fps Animation Loop
  let lastTime = performance.now();
  function animate(now) {
    const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - lastTime) / 1000);
    lastTime = now;
    state.time += dt;

    updateCapybaraRig(dt);
    drawWorld(dt);
    updateAndDrawFX(dt);

    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
})();
